findings.what:
HOLDER RULE (a plan amendment, no new mechanism): put the one SEC file of W2 on the file that HOLDS our row at W2a time, not on exp70g.
MECHANISM. Our LB row shows only the max over our files.
- On a non-holder, a lever can read '+' only through a display step (>= the next 0.001 edge). The '0.956 with UP' channel is dead, and v3 codes that case '?'.
- On the holder, '+' needs only an unrounded gain > ~2e-5 (the gap to the next team in a 52-team block).
ARITHMETIC.
- Holder margin today: exp70g is 9th of 52 in the 0.956 block at 22:30Z, so its unrounded score is ~0.9565 - 8.5/52 x 1e-3 ~ 0.95634 (uniform in-block density, round-18 method). That is ~1.6e-4 below the 0.957 edge.
- If exp78b becomes holder at 0.957, exp81 (SEC on exp70g) needs +6.6e-4 or more to show 0.957 and can never show an UP. On exp78b (exp82b), any gain > ~2e-5 shows.
- For SEC's plausible public effect N(0, ~8e-4), this raises P(detect a real gain) from ~0.20 to ~0.45.
- The on-holder file is also already the stacked candidate, which saves one step on 29 Sep.
RULE.
- W2a SEC file = exp81 if exp70g holds the row, exp82a if exp78a holds it.
- If exp78b holds it: exp82b, which goes to W2b because W2a is exp80a in that row.
- Code it against its own base display (v3 (1)).
- Its dummy gates follow the N2 pre-registration: SHA256 line 7029fe69, nodes within -2%/+1% of 121,252, 0 errors, <= 1,920 s.
PRE-REGISTRATION CONDITION. The N2 pre-registration (21:06Z) fixes exp70g as the base. This amendment is valid only if it is logged in CONTEXT before exp78b's terminal header (earliest ~07:30Z 28 Sep), quoting that header with exp78b PENDING. Otherwise v3 stands unchanged.
COST. ~0.4 GPU-h per lazy dummy. Hidden-run runtime cost is ~0: secswap only swaps weights (dummy 1,305-1,402 s vs ~1,300-1,500 s for K2-like files).

findings.what:
WHEN TO STOP THE CAP DIRECTION. This consolidates v3 (6) and (8) and loosens nothing.
S1. exp78a and exp78b both '-' or '0' -> DIV volume is closed. The holder stays exp70g; exp80a never goes; no DIV file in W3/W4.
S2. exp78a '+' and exp78b not '+' -> stop at cap 8. No cap 10/16 interpolation, no fc2 on cap 8.
S3. exp78b '+' -> exp80a goes in W2a.
- If exp80a reads strictly above exp78b (by display, or equal with an attributable UP), ONE more step is allowed in W3: exp84a (cap 48 fc2, sha 4cb1e47b). It is allowed only because it is then the second strict step (exp70g < exp78b < exp80a).
- If exp80a <= exp78b -> stop at cap 12.
S4. A '?' DIV read (MASKED, BLIND, 'v', ERR) is never a strict step. It can hold the base by display, but it never licenses the next dose.
S5. Any DIV step that reads '-' ends the direction. No step back to an intermediate dose.
S6. Hard end: no DIV-only file after W3 (29 Sep 01:45Z), and at most 4 DIV-volume files in total from now (exp78a, exp78b, exp80a, exp84a).
WHY STOP THERE.
- Each extra dose draws lower-scored DaughterNet candidates (median 0.505 at the cap-6 margin vs 0.587 for cap 4).
- The lab from cap 12 upward is in-sample, and its CI90 includes 0.
- The display is a single-embryo read of ~1-4 evaluable events. So each further step has P(<= base - 0.001) ~0.27-0.30, while its private mean falls.
- MC (r21) for C12 - C, the cap-12 step over cap 6 on private: mean -3e-4, sd 4e-3, P(>0) ~0.39. In the lab-like world: -2.2e-3, P(>0) 0.17.
